title: Pufferfish Love
description: Adds powerful pufferfish-themed weapons and entities to Minecraft.
body:
# Pufferfish Love

"Dull and uninteresting"—that kind of pufferfish is kind of sad, isn't it? This mod adds an incredibly powerful pufferfish and a sword. Be sure to try pitting them against powerful items and entities from other mods.

## Key Features

### Pufferfish Love Entity

This entity will never die under any circumstances. When summoned, it colors the sky with a rainbow and causes rain to fall. It also imposes some restrictions on the player's actions. If this entity becomes a nuisance, you can make it disappear by reloading the world.

### Pufferfish Love Sword

This sword includes a basic entity removal method. It can remove most entities, but it isn't very powerful. We plan to enhance it in the future.

## Compatibility

Minecraft Version: 1.20.1

Mod Loader: Forge

Dependencies: None!
